We have IR spectrum data. Need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups. Carbonyl shows strong absorption around 1700 cm-1 (typically 1650-1750). The provided wavenumbers: 3357, 3091, ... up to 1606, 1587. No peak near 1700. So likely zero carbonyl groups. However maybe carbonyl could be around 1680 for conjugated, but not present. So answer 0.

But ensure no hidden data. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). Could request carbon NMR. But IR lacking carbonyl suggests none. To be safe, maybe request carbon NMR to confirm. But cost minimal. Let's request carbon_nmr_spectra.
